job_desc:
About the roleAs a Performance Engineer at PT. SIGMA GLOBAL TEKNOLOGI (SIGMATECH), you will play a vital role in ensuring the seamless and efficient performance of our software systems. This full-time position is based in South Tangerang Banten, where you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimising the performance of our technology solutions.
Technical Requirements (Tech Stack)
1. Performance Testing Tools
* Expertise in JMeter: Advanced scripting, custom samplers, and Groovy/BeanShell scripting.
* Expertise in LoadRunner: Proficiency in Web HTTP/HTML, TruClient, and Web Services protocols.
* K6 or Gatling: (Optional/Plus) Experience with modern "as-code" performance tools.
2. Observability & Monitoring
* APM Tools: Hands-on experience with Dynatrace, New Relic, or AppDynamics to monitor transaction snapshots and code-level hotspots.
* Infrastructure: Ability to analyze metrics in Prometheus & Grafana.
* Log Management: Proficiency in searching and visualizing logs via ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) or Splunk.
3. Systems & Infrastructure
* Architecture: Deep understanding of Microservices, Load Balancers (NGINX/F5), and Caching layers (Redis).
* Cloud & Containers: Familiarity with Docker & Kubernetes (K8s) monitoring (pod health, resource limits).
* Databases: Ability to identify slow queries and understand indexing in PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle.
What we're looking for
* Workload Modeling: Analyze production usage patterns (via Google Analytics or logs) to create realistic performance test scenarios.
* End-to-End Testing: Design and execute Load, Stress, Endurance, and Scalability tests.
* Bottleneck Diagnosis: Analyze Thread Dumps, Heap Dumps, and Garbage Collection (GC) behavior to identify memory leaks or locking issues.
* Shift-Left Performance: Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, or Azure DevOps) for automated performance gating.
* Capacity Planning: Provide recommendations on hardware/cloud resource scaling based on test results.
Soft Skills & Qualifications
* Analytical Mindset: You don't just report "the system is slow"; you find out which line of code or which database query is the culprit.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex technical bottlenecks to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience: 3+ years in Performance Testing/Engineering or Software Development.

•Platform:AWS, Gravitee API Management

Infrastructure-as-Code.

title: QA Manual
job_desc:
QA Manual (Quality Assurance Manual Tester) adalah profesional yang bertanggung jawab menguji aplikasi secara manual untuk memastikan aplikasi berjalan sesuai kebutuhan, bebas dari bug, dan memberikan pengalaman yang baik bagi pengguna.
Berikut job desk / tanggung jawab utama QA Manual:
1. Membuat Test Case• Menyusun test case berdasarkan requirement atau spesifikasi sistem.• Menentukan skenario pengujian untuk memastikan semua fitur bekerja dengan benar.
2. Melakukan Pengujian Aplikasi• Menguji aplikasi secara manual tanpa menggunakan script otomatis.• Menguji berbagai fitur pada: Web application, Mobile application, Sistem backend atau API
3. Menemukan dan Melaporkan Bug• Mengidentifikasi bug atau error pada aplikasi.• Melaporkan bug menggunakan tools seperti: Jira, Trello, TestRail• Menjelaskan langkah-langkah reproduksi bug.
4. Verifikasi Perbaikan Bug• Menguji kembali fitur yang sudah diperbaiki oleh developer.• Memastikan bug benar-benar sudah fix dan tidak muncul kembali.
5. Melakukan Regression Testing• Menguji kembali fitur lama setelah ada update sistem.• Memastikan perubahan kode tidak merusak fitur yang sudah ada.
6. Melakukan UAT Support (User Acceptance Testing)• Membantu proses User Acceptance Testing dengan stakeholder atau user.• Memastikan sistem sesuai kebutuhan bisnis.
7. Dokumentasi Testing• Mendokumentasikan hasil testing.• Membuat laporan kualitas aplikasi sebelum release.
8. Kolaborasi dengan Tim

title: Product Specialist Officer (Printer, Scanner, & Peripherals)
job_desc:
Blibli is on a journey to become Indonesia’s #1 e-commerce platform— built on trust, innovation, and care. We’re creating better experiences for customers, merchants, brands, and sellers through technology, collaboration, and a deep commitment to quality. Here, every idea matters and every action helps us grow stronger together.
InB2B business unit,you'll responsible for managing sales and services targeted at other businesses rather than individual consumers. This unit acts as a strategic partner for corporate clients, handling bulk orders, customized product bundles, and competitive pricing. It manages RFQs (Request for Quotations), negotiates with vendors and distributors, ensures stock availability, and provides tailored solutions to meet client needs.
AsProduct Specialist Officer (Printer, Scanner, and Peripherals), you will act as the bridge between our sales team and vendors, ensuring smooth fulfillment of client requirements for printers, scanners, and peripheral products.   - Check and confirmpricing and stock availabilitywith vendors.
  - Maintain strong and professional relationships with vendors to ensure long-term collaboration.
  - Collaborate with internal teams (sales, finance, operations) to ensure timely and accurate fulfillment of client needs.
  - Monitor market trends and vendor performance to optimize sourcing strategies.
Qualifications:
  - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, or related field.
  - Minimum 3–4 years of experience in printer/scanner category management or vendor sourcing (preferably in B2B environment).
  - Strong negotiation and communication skills.
  - Good understanding of printer, scanner, and peripheral products.
  - Ability to manage multiple RFQs and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  - Proficient in MS Excel and data analysis for pricing and stock management.
  - Strong relationship-building skills with vendors and internal stakeholders.

title: IT Network Infrastructure Specialist
job_desc:
About the Role
We are looking for anIT Network Infrastructure Specialistto manage and optimize our organization’s network infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and securing our network environment across core, distribution, and access layers to ensure reliable and high-performing connectivity.
You will play a critical role in maintaining enterprise-grade network operations, from managing routing and switching to ensuring secure internet connectivity and wireless infrastructure. The role also involves monitoring network health, supporting audits and compliance requirements, and maintaining accurate documentation of the network ecosystem.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working hands-on with network systems, solving connectivity challenges, and ensuring the stability and security of IT infrastructure in a growing organization.
What You'll Do
Network Infrastructure Management
  - Manage and maintain core network infrastructure includingrouting, switching, and firewall configurations.
  - Implement and troubleshootLayer 2 and Layer 3 protocols, including VLANs and both static and dynamic routing.
  - Managecore, distribution, and access layer switchesto ensure optimal network performance.
Wireless Infrastructure
  - Design, deploy, and optimizeenterprise-grade wireless networks.
  - Manage WLAN controllers and performheat mapping and RF interference troubleshooting.
  - Work with wireless technologies such asAruba, Ruckus, or Cisco.
Network Security & Edge Connectivity
  - Configure and maintainNext-Generation Firewallssuch as Fortinet, Cisco, or Sangfor.
  - ManageVPN environments, including site-to-site and remote access VPNs.
  - SupportSD-WAN deployments and connectivity optimization.
Internet Connectivity Management
  - Manage relationships withInternet Service Providers (ISP).
  - Ensure network resilience throughredundant failover setups and bandwidth load balancing.
Network Administration
  - Administer and monitornetwork access accounts and policies.
  - Manage blocked sites and program tracking to enforce network usage policies.
Monitoring, Audit & Compliance
  - Monitor network performance using tools such asWhatsUp Gold, PRTG, Zabbix, Cacti, or Grafana.
  - Conductregular network auditsand ensure compliance with standards such asISO 27001, SOC2, or PCI-DSS.
  - Analyze network metrics including uptime, latency, and traffic patterns.
Documentation & Asset Management
  - Maintain accuratenetwork topology diagrams and IP Address Management (IPAM)records.
  - Tracknetwork hardware lifecycle, including maintenance, migration, firmware updates, decommissioning, and license renewals.
  - Maintainchange management logsfor infrastructure updates and modifications.
What You'll Need
  - Bachelor’s degree inInformation Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  - 3+ years of experiencemanaging enterprise network infrastructure.
  - Strong understanding ofnetwork architecture, routing, switching, and firewall management.
  - Experience withenterprise wireless infrastructure deployment and optimization.
  - Hands-on experience withVPN, SD-WAN, and network security technologies.
  - Familiarity withnetwork monitoring and logging toolssuch as PRTG, Zabbix, or Grafana.
  - Experience conductingnetwork audits and supporting compliance requirements.
  - Proven experience handlingoffice network setups, relocations, or full infrastructure refresh projects.
  - Professional networking certifications such asCCNA, CCNP, MTCNA, or MTCREare a plus.

title: IT Retail Solution Manager
job_desc:
The IT Retail Solution Manager is responsible for leading the design, development, governance,
and continuous improvement of retail technology solutions that support business operations
and strategic initiatives. This role ensures all retail systems — including ERP, POS, and other
retail applications — are scalable, secure, cloud-ready, and aligned with business objectives
while delivering measurable value across the organization.
The role requires strong retail business understanding, hands-on ERP oversight, cloud
experience, vendor management capability, and strong English communication skills.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
1. Solution Strategy & Architecture
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand retail operational requirements
and translate them into scalable IT solutions.
• Design and oversee integrated system architecture across retail, supply chain, finance,
merchandising, and customer experience platforms.
• Ensure alignment between ERP, POS, CRM, and other retail applications.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption aligned with retail
transformation initiatives.
• Ensure solutions are cloud-ready and follow best practices in scalability, resilience, and
security.
________________________________________
2. ERP & Retail Application Management
• Directly oversee ERP implementation, enhancement, and support activities.
• Manage POS systems and other retail applications through internal teams and QA
functions.
• Ensure system performance, reliability, and business continuity across stores and head
office.
• Lead system optimization initiatives to improve retail efficiency and customer
experience.
• Ensure proper QA governance across all retail technology releases.
________________________________________
3. Project & Delivery Management
• Lead end-to-end solution delivery, including planning, budgeting, resource allocation,
and timeline management.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams (developers, QA, vendors, and business users).
• Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
• Manage change management and rollout strategy across retail stores.
________________________________________
4. Vendor & Stakeholder Management
• Manage relationships with external vendors, implementation partners, and service
providers.
________________________________________
5. Governance, Compliance & Security
• Ensure compliance with internal policies, industry standards, and regulatory
requirements.
• Maintain documentation and conduct system audits.
• Ensure cybersecurity, data privacy, and cloud governance standards are enforced.
• Implement best practices in cloud-native and Kubernetes-based deployments.
________________________________________
6. Team Leadership
• Lead and mentor ERP, POS, and application teams including QA.
• Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Build a high-performing retail IT capability.
________________________________________
Job Specification
Education & Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
• Master’s degree or certifications (TOGAF, PMP, ITIL) are a plus.
________________________________________
Experience
• Minimum 10 years of experience in IT, with at least 3–5 years in retail solution
architecture or retail IT management.
• Strong experience managing ERP systems directly (preferably Oracle ERP or similar
enterprise platforms).
• Experience overseeing POS systems and other retail applications.
• Proven experience in retail or consumer-facing industries.

Contribute hands-on to the development of secure, user-friendly edtech platforms, experimenting with emerging technologies to improve product features, performance, and scalability from prototyping through deployment.

Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning, providing clear technical guidance, feedback, and professional development while ensuring effective resource allocation and on-time delivery.

You’ll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don’t expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you’re looking for a conventional technology role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re ready to build innovative solutions, lead technical initiatives, and create real-world impact through technology, we’d love to hear from you.

• Set up and maintain application and infrastructure monitoring, logging, and alerting for critical services.
• Define basic incident handling flows (detection, triage, escalation) together with Engineering and PM/BA.

• Implement and maintain IAM, access control, and secrets management in line with least-privilege principles.
• Apply basic security hardening for cloud resources, deployment pipelines, and credentials.
• Collaborate with engineers and management to balance security, cost, and delivery speed.

• Work closely with Backend Engineers, QA, and PM/BA to ensure the platform and pipelines fit real delivery needs.
• Produce clear, practical documentation so other engineers can understand and operate the systems you build.

title: Website Maintenance & QA Officer
job_desc:
We are hiring a Web Maintenance & QA Officer to support the stability, performance, and optimization of websites across our client ecosystem in the agency (www.gaiada.com).
This is a full-time on-site position based in Ubud, Bali. You and your team will work closely to ensure that all client websites remain functional, optimized, and performing well at all times. You will be working daily from Mon-Fri, 9am to 6pm. English is the business language of the company, so intermediate English is required.
Your role is a hybrid between web developer and quality assurance tester. You will be responsible for maintaining existing client websites, identifying issues, performing visual and functional testing, and fixing bugs when necessary. Your work ensures that the websites we manage continue to operate smoothly and meet performance standards. You may also be in contact with the client to ensure client are accountable with the services.
You will conduct regular website audits, including daily and weekly checks, to ensure each website is functioning properly. This includes testing layouts, forms, CTA, booking engine, responsiveness, links, integrations with 3rd party services, and other key website components across different devices and browsers, so cross-browser testing skill is needed.
In addition to maintenance and testing, you will help ensure the websites maintain strong performance and technical health. This includes monitoring website performance using tools such as Lighthouse, pageSpeed (pagespeed.web.dev) and ensuring websites remain optimized for speed and performance.
You will also support basic on-page SEO implementation, helping ensure proper meta tags, page structure, indexing readiness, and other SEO elements are correctly implemented to support SEO performance.
The majority of websites we manage are built using wordpress, so strong familiarity with wordpress is important. Experience with other CMS platforms is a plus.
This role requires someone with a web development background who is comfortable working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related web technologies as well as familiar with CMS of a website. You should be capable of troubleshooting issues, fixing bugs, update contents, and improving website functionality when needed.The websites that you're handle will come in a different frameworks and technology, so knowledge of the latest web technology trend and programming language (react, node, etc) is a huge plus.
You will also handle support requests from clients and internal teams, assisting with updates, adjustments, and improvements to existing client websites across various industries. You should be able to assist and ensuring the changes didn't break the website.
If you are someone who enjoys maintaining websites, solving technical issues, and ensuring websites stay fast, functional, and optimized, this role is for you.

[Requirements]
Candidates should have a background in IT, Web Development, or a related technical field. Experience working with websites or create some website is required.
You should be comfortable working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic web development practices in order to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
Strong familiarity with wordpress is important, including understanding themes, plugins, and basic website management. Knowledge of other CMS platforms will be considered a plus.
Knowledge of latest trend of web technology and language is a plus.
Experience performing quality assurance testing, including visual testing, functional testing, and bug identification, is required.
You should understand basic on-page SEO principles and how website structure, meta tags, and performance affect search visibility.
You should know what good UI/UX of a website should be and should be able to identify what improvement should be made.
Ability to audit website performance and ensure websites maintain good PageSpeed scores is important.
Strong attention to detail, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple websites at once are essential for this role.
Good documentation and report creating capability is a must.
Good English is needed to ensure communication across client and team member is clearly understood.
Knowledge of deployment and website infrastructure in general is a plus.
This role is suitable for junior to mid-level candidates who want to develop both technical and QA skills within a digital agency environment.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect-RISE-Indonesia
job_desc:
We help the world run betterAt SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
Meet Your Team
Join our dynamic SAP Enterprise Architects team within the new SAP Customer Services & Delivery board. We lead digital transformation using cutting-edge SAP technologies, advancing the RISE with SAP initiative, promoting Clean Core principles, and accelerating SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) adoption. Our mission is to simplify and modernize IT landscapes, reducing complexity and operational costs, while fostering innovation and efficiency to support evolving business needs.
What you’ll do:
As a Principal Enterprise Architect, you will develop a comprehensive enterprise architecture model for our customers aligning with their enterprise goals, collaborate with virtual account teams (VAT) as a transformation partner. You will drive the value realization and the solution adoption and lead activities such as:
  - Guide customers through their cloud journey (with special focus on adopt and derive), starting with Enterprise archetypes and scaling digitally.
  - Provide enterprise architecture guidance using RISE with SAP methodology and Clean Core principles to ensure that every customer benefits from SAP‘s cloud qualities.
  - Act as the Transformation Partner for the CIO or other CxO, driving architecture effectiveness.
  - Support adoption, identifying and mitigating technical adoption risks.
  - Enhance impact on customer’s business goals by driving value realization through solution adoption and consumption of capabilities
  - Bundle customer expectations and align business goals in a tangible enterprise level success plan to monitor and validate KPIs & value drivers to enable value-driven business transformation with value framework
  - Serve as a trusted advisor, ensuring secure, reliable, and flexible cloud environments for mission-critical processes.
  - Through governance, involve and engage relevant stakeholders within and outside the customer organization to enhance value realization, establish a common perspective on customer business goals and value drivers across solution areas to provide customer context to all teams, enhancing customer proximity and experience.
  - Align customers and partners with SAP’s Clean Core strategy, accelerate BTP adoption and promote SAP best practices.
What You Bring:
Transformation, Architectural & Solution Skills:
  - Experience delivering enterprise business transformation projects and aligning customer priorities with target architecture and roadmap.
  - In-depth knowledge of the SAP Solution Portfolio and Enterprise Architecture Framework (North Star).
  - Experience with Business Technology Platform components (application development, automation, data and analytics, integration, AI) and practical experience with S/4HANA applications.
  - Strong understanding of Cloud & Clean Core Strategy, familiarity with SAP LeanIX, Signavio, and Cloud ALM.
  - Knowledge of SAP's Business AI roadmap, including identifying use cases and piloting AI-driven solutions to enhance business processes.
  - Expertise in SAP Integration and Extensibility Advisory Methodologies.
  - Understanding of SAP’s value framework, value drivers and business case creation with e.g. VLM (SAP value lifecycle manager)
Must-Have Requirements:
  - 10+ years in customer experience roles (e.g., Program Manager, Architect), with experience in end-to-end architectural design for hybrid solution landscapes.
  - Extensive knowledge of SAP Enterprise Architecture Framework and Toolset, and experience with BTP components and services such as application development, automation, data and analytics, integration, and AI capabilities.
  - Proficiency in SAP Integration and Extensibility Advisory Methodologies and Clean Core principles.
  - S/4HANA technical or/and SAP S/4HANA application/functional knowledge/experience.
  - Excellent communication, influencing, and negotiation skills (in English) at the senior management and C-levels, both within an IT team and across business functions.
  - Mindset for Strategic Thinking, Continuous Learning, and Business Acumen.
Nice-to-Have Requirements:
  - Knowledge of on-premise and corresponding SAP cloud solutions.
  - Professional training and certification (e.g., SAP Enterprise Architecture Framework featured by LeanIX EAM, SAP Certified Professional-Enterprise Architect [P_SAPEA_2023], TOGAF) as a plus.
